whatItDoes: Plans how long it takes to save a home down payment based on your goal, current savings, monthly contribution, and the interest your savings earn.
whyItExists: A down payment is often the biggest savings goal a household sets, and the timeline depends on far more than the goal itself. Knowing the time to goal — and the monthly amount required — turns an abstract target into a concrete plan.
whoShouldUse: First-time homebuyers, renters building a deposit, and anyone setting a specific savings goal with a target amount.
useCases: Estimate how long it takes to reach a down payment goal
Check if your current monthly savings is enough
See how interest on savings speeds things up
Plan how much more to save to hit a target date
instructions: Enter the annual interest rate on your savings account
Read the time to goal, final balance, and interest earned
bestPractices: Use the actual interest rate your savings account pays
Re-run the plan as your balance grows or needs change
Keep a buffer above the exact down payment for closing costs
commonMistakes: Ignoring interest your current balance already earns
Choosing a monthly amount you can't sustain
Forgetting closing costs on top of the down payment
Assuming no income change over the savings period
faq: Does this include closing costs? — No, it targets the down payment amount you enter.
What rate should I use? — The rate your savings actually earns, often 3-5%.
Can I plan for a future savings amount? — Yes, change monthly savings and re-run to see the schedule.
Is my data shared? — No, everything runs locally in your browser.
